name: Phantom Steed

targets.description: an unoccupied space on the ground within range

summary: Summon a Large quasi-real horse (Riding Horse, Speed 100 ft., 13 miles per hour) for 1 hour.
text: A Large, quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 feet. You choose how it looks, and it comes with a saddle, bit and bridle; any of that gear vanishes in a puff of smoke if carried more than 10 feet from the steed. For 1 hour, you or a creature you choose can ride it. It uses the Riding Horse stat block, except that its Speed is 100 feet and it can travel 13 miles in an hour. The spell ends early if the steed takes any damage. When the spell ends, the steed fades gradually, giving its rider 1 minute to dismount. Casting time 1 minute; can be cast as a Ritual.
